usage_daily.title: Tokens and value by day
usage_daily.description: Requests, tokens (fresh input, output, thinking, cache read and write), web searches and estimated API-equivalent value per day, model and role (main session or sub-agent). From local Claude Code and Cowork transcripts via the usage-dashboard collector.

sessions.title: Sessions by day
sessions.description: One row per session per active day: title, project folder, main model, prompts, active minutes, tokens, sub-agents, tool calls, lines written and API-equivalent value. Sessions whose transcript was gone before the ledger began carry tokens_known false.

hourly.title: Requests by hour
hourly.description: Model requests per day and local hour, main sessions and sub-agents together.

subagents.title: Sub-agents launched
subagents.description: One row per sub-agent or workflow agent that called the model: start time, parent session, kind, workflow, task, main model, requests, tokens, tool calls and API-equivalent value.

tools.title: Tool calls by day
tools.description: Tool calls per day, tool and role, with the kind of work each tool belongs to (commands, reading, editing, delegation, web research, literature, publishing, planning).

summary.title: Board figures by period
summary.description: Headline figures for the last 7, 30 and 90 days and all time, each with the same-length period before it and weekly or daily trends for both periods, computed by the collector on the day it runs.
